entries.subject: Published radar dimensions as a smooth shape approximation
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Table 3: SAM1, P=11.1 h, a=4.58 km, axial ratio 2.60; section 4. Absolute published semiaxes supply a smooth ellipsoid; this is not a retrieved radar terrain mesh, and its attitude is illustrative.

entries.subject: Original PDS or JPL radar surface mesh
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: No downloadable original mesh for this nucleus identified. Use the cited numeric shape constraints; unresolved mesh access is not evidence of absence.
entries.revisitWhen: A downloadable original model with its units, frame and reuse record is located.

entries.subject: Delay-Doppler imagery as an optical texture
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Shape constraints only. Delay-Doppler images are not optical surface maps and are not draped as texture.
entries.revisitWhen: A separately qualified radar observable is proposed with its own physical meaning, or resolved optical photographs become available.

entries.subject: Resolved optical or infrared surface map
entries.finding: Retained intake decision: Constrain size and rotation; no resolved optical surface texture selected.
entries.revisitWhen: Resolved surface observations and camera or terrain controls support a reproducible mapping.

entries.subject: Encke alternative elongation and SAM2 solutions
entries.finding: Table 3 also considers axis ratio 2.04 and a slower SAM2 case. The selected 2.60 SAM1 case better matches the reported infrared size; it is not a unique shape solution. Similar alternative illustrations are documented without extra datasets.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent observations distinguish the alternative shapes or justify a useful comparison.
